SELECT DISTINCT ?country
WHERE {
  {
    ?singer1 a :singer ;
             :singer\#age ?age1 ;
             :singer\#country ?country .
    FILTER(?age1 > 40)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?singer2 a :singer ;
             :singer\#age ?age2 ;
             :singer\#country ?country .
    FILTER(?age2 < 30)
  }
}

SELECT DISTINCT ?stadium_name ?stadium_location
WHERE {
  ?concert a :concert .
  ?concert :concert\#year ?year .
  FILTER (?year IN ("2014", "2015"))
  
  ?concert :concert\#ref-stadium_id ?stadium .
  ?stadium a :stadium .
  ?stadium :stadium\#name ?stadium_name .
  ?stadium :stadium\#location ?stadium_location .

  {
    SELECT ?concert_id
    WHERE {
      ?concert a :concert .
      ?concert :concert\#year "2014" .
    }
    GROUP BY ?concert_id
    HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?concert_id) > 0)
  }
  
  {
    SELECT ?concert_id
    WHERE {
      ?concert a :concert .
      ?concert :concert\#year "2015" .
    }
    GROUP BY ?concert_id
    HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?concert_id) > 0)
  }
  
  FILTER EXISTS {
    ?concert1 a :concert .
    ?concert1 :concert\#year "2014" .
    ?concert1 :concert\#concert_id ?concert_id .
    ?concert2 a :concert .
    ?concert2 :concert\#year "2015" .
    ?concert2 :concert\#concert_id ?concert_id .
  }
}
